subject.title: fix(agents): protect provider auth exchange output by sensitivity, not input marker

question: After real implicit-Mantle proof is added, does the auth/secrets owner approve treating every non-empty, non-marker provider runtime-auth output as sensitive at this shared boundary?
rationale: The implementation appears technically sound, but it deliberately expands the permanent credential-classification contract beyond inputs already marked as SecretRef-derived.

options.title: Approve central output classification
options.body: Use the shared output-value rule for all provider hooks and rely on the existing fail-closed egress unwrap.

options.title: Require provider-declared sensitivity
options.body: Pause and redesign PreparedProviderRuntimeAuth so providers explicitly declare which returned values are secret.

recommendation.title: Approve central output classification
recommendation.body: Use the shared output-value rule for all provider hooks and rely on the existing fail-closed egress unwrap.
